newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Thousands of Cyprus pupils demand more lessons.
newsitem.headline: Thousands of Cyprus pupils demand more lessons.

text.p: Thousands of Cypriot pupils staged a two-hour walkout on Tuesday to protest against their teachers' refusal to give them extra lessons, organisers said.

Secondary school students have warned they will refuse to go to classes altogether unless the teacher's union reconsiders its refusal to teach in state-run afternoon institutes, which some 11,000 students attend.
The dispute began last week when two teachers were booked by police for giving extra lessons at home. As civil servants, teachers in government schools are forbidden from holding two jobs.
